title: Coolie
desc: Zafar's obsession destroys Salma's family and shatters her mind. Years later, her sons Iqbal and Sunny unite to rescue her from his captivity and confront their dark past.

title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain
desc: Ganga, a kind-hearted villager raised by foster parents, returns to his biological family in the city but struggles to adjust to modern life and its contrasting values.

title: Badla
desc: Naina, a successful entrepreneur, is accused when her lover dies mysteriously. She hires a renowned lawyer to uncover the truth and clear her name in this tense legal battle.

title: Karma
desc: To avenge an insult, a terrorist kills a jailer's family. Seeking revenge, the jailer enlists three death-row inmates to help him carry out his daring plan.

title: Ground Zero
desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

title: Lakshya
desc: Karan, a carefree youth, joins the Army but quits facing its hardships. When his actions strain his relationship, he returns determined to prove his courage and earn respect.

title: Chintu Ka Birthday
desc: An immigrant family in Iraq faces chaos when soldiers storm their home during a birthday celebration, exposing them to the harsh realities of conflict and fear.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: 3 A.M.
desc: Sunny, Raj and Cyrus attempt a ghost-hunting reality show at a haunted site, but their plan spirals into terror as real supernatural forces strike, leading to deadly consequences.

title: Kudrat
desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and realizes she was Paro in a past life. Seeking justice for her tragic past, she sets out to confront those responsible.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

title: Barsaat (1995)
desc: Badal likes his classmate Tina, but her father disapproves. The father falsely gets him arrested, trying to end their relationship before it goes any further.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.
